authors: V. G. Gerasimov, S. F. Dyubko, M. N. Efimenko, V. A. Efremov, V. B. Podoba, S. V. Podnos, A. V. Reznik
title: Measurement of microwave transition frequencies involving the Rydberg states of sodium atoms
method: atomic-beam microwave spectroscopy 39-156 GHz, pulsed dye-laser excitation via 3P, field ionization (predecessor apparatus of dyubko1995pra)
uncertainty: 'scatter not exceeding +-2 MHz for most frequencies'; asterisked lines worse (poor S/N)
conversion: Not exported, intervals from a reference that is no single level: 2 rows (35D3/2,5/2 - 36D3/2,5/2, 35D3/2,5/2 - 37P1/2).
caveats: Low precision (~2 MHz), some lines with poor S/N (flagged); values scatter by up to +7 MHz from dyubko1995pra for the same transitions.
Values printed with decimal commas; converted to decimal points (notation only).
Row 11 number misprinted as 1' in both the Russian original and the English translation (the English Table I reproduces the Russian table layout).

The English text calls the three-photon resonance '35D -> 37D'; the Russian text and both tables say 35D -> 37P (37P1/2), which is also the only parity-allowed assignment; levels.csv follows the tables.
The English translation is not a fully independent typesetting of Table I (same layout and misprint); the agreement confirms the transcription of the Russian scan, not the authors' numbers.
